description: What central bankers everywhere are saying, from the BIS's collection of their speeches: the latest fifty with speaker, role and bank, title, date and link; one bank's (ECB, Bank of England, Bundesbank, Bank of Japan...) or one speaker's; or one speech read, brief excerpts of its passages on policy. A plain summary first. No key.

bank.description: A central bank by name or short name (ECB, Bank of England, Bundesbank, BoJ, RBA...): its speakers' speeches.

limit.description: Most speeches listed, newest first; default 15.

read.description: A speech page on bis.org (a link from the list): its paragraphs on monetary policy, quoted.

speaker.description: A speaker by surname (Lagarde, Bailey, Nagel...).

name: central_bank_speeches

outputSchema.description: rows are speeches (newest first) in the order of columns; with read, rows are brief excerpts of the speech's passages on policy.

title: Central bankers' speeches (BIS)
